preview.text: Sydney Thunder Women and Melbourne Renegades Women meet in a T20 match at Blacktown Olympic Park No 2 Oval, following 17 recorded T20 meetings where Sydney Thunder Women won 8 and Melbourne Renegades Women won 9. Sydney Thunder Women won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 53 per cent chance of rain and about 19 degrees.

summary.text: Sydney Thunder Women won by 5 wkts after restricting MLRW to 121-9, where Courtney Webb scored 27 off 24 balls and Alexandra Mavros took 4 for 11. In reply, SYTW reached 95-3 with Anika Learoyd top scoring with 38 off 26 balls while Annabell Glossop claimed 2 for 19.
